department: Department of Biostatistics and Medical Informatics

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 (2026) for Fall 2027; fall entry only.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: You do at least two research rotations in the first fall before settling on a mentor.
supervisor.quote: At least two rotations (4-6 credits in following course), each spanning 4 weeks during the fall semester need to be completed.

funding.value: Almost all accepted students receive guaranteed five-year funding (training grants, TA or RA).
funding.quote: The program is designed such that almost all students who are accepted to the program will receive guaranteed funding for five years.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's in a data-science area (CS, statistics) or as a health professional; you need calculus, programming and data structures.
entry_route.quote: Potential applicants include both those with bachelor’s degrees in an area of data-science (e.g., computer science, statistics), as well as health professionals and clinicians

notes: Combines biostatistics, biomedical informatics and computer science.
name: Biomedical Data Science PhD
